rogues.bio: Leads every charge, mostly by accident.
rogues.name: Captain Carrot

rogues.bio: Sits so still in the ferns that moss grows on her.
rogues.name: Vex

rogues.bio: Only comes out at dusk. Never forgets a face.
rogues.name: Bunnicula
rogues.says: I smelled you from the other hill.

rogues.bio: Has survived nine matches by never being anywhere.
rogues.name: Lop-Eared Larry

rogues.bio: Thinks a 300-carrot belt is a joke. It is not a joke.
rogues.name: Snickerdoodle

rogues.bio: One target, one breath, one carrot.
rogues.name: Cottontail Kate

rogues.bio: Treats the rocket launcher as a club. Also uses it as one.
rogues.name: Hops McGee
rogues.says: Close enough to kiss, close enough to boom!

rogues.bio: Has never once stood still. Not even asleep.
rogues.name: Nutsy

rogues.bio: Keeps forty acorns in each cheek and a grudge in his heart.
rogues.name: Acorn Al

rogues.bio: Challenges everyone to a duel at dawn. Dawn is whenever he says.
rogues.name: Sir Scamper

rogues.bio: Picks her branch, picks her shot.
rogues.name: Hazel

rogues.bio: Jumps at every sound. Lands shooting.
rogues.name: Twitch

rogues.bio: Builds a nest, sits in it, rockets anyone who knocks.
rogues.name: Kernel
rogues.says: Please wipe your feet. And duck.

rogues.bio: Arrives just after the fight, just in time to finish it.
rogues.name: Bushytail Betty
rogues.says: Oh, are you two busy? Don't mind me.

rogues.bio: Follows tracks nobody else can see.
rogues.name: Sly

rogues.bio: Every shot is a trick shot, and she'll tell you about it.
rogues.name: Vixen Vera
rogues.says: From up here you all look like snacks.

rogues.bio: Big ears, bigger temper.
rogues.name: Fennick

rogues.bio: Circles you like a game of tag she's winning.
rogues.name: Foxy Roxy

rogues.bio: A gentleman: always lets you shoot first. Once.
rogues.name: Sir Reynard

rogues.bio: Likes things loud and bright and on (carrot) fire.
rogues.name: Ember

rogues.bio: Holds the high ground like she owns it. She thinks she does.
rogues.name: Duchess

rogues.bio: Steals kills, steals loot, steals the show.
rogues.name: Bandit Bill

rogues.bio: Rummages through every crate, bin and pocket.
rogues.name: Trash Panda

rogues.bio: Leads with his face. It has worked so far.
rogues.name: Rocco

rogues.bio: You won't see the mask until it's too late.
rogues.name: Masky

rogues.bio: Has lived through worse than you. Has lived IN worse than you.
rogues.name: Dumpster Dot
rogues.says: Patience. Everyone runs out of carrots.

rogues.bio: Complains about everything, the director most of all.
rogues.name: Grimsby

rogues.bio: Collects only the finest refuse. And rockets.
rogues.name: Lady Garbage

rogues.bio: Waits in the reeds with a shotgun and a grudge.
rogues.name: Croaker

rogues.bio: Sits on one lily pad all match. It is a very well defended lily pad.
rogues.name: Lily Pad Lou

rogues.bio: Hops in patterns only she understands.
rogues.name: Hopscotch

rogues.bio: A gentleman of means. Means a lot of carrots in the air.
rogues.name: Sir Toadsworth

rogues.bio: Afraid of everything except finishing off the wounded.
rogues.name: Puddles
rogues.says: Is it hurt? Can I... sorry!

rogues.bio: Runs at you with a carrot machine gun. Every time. It works.
rogues.name: Bog Boss

rogues.bio: Swallows his fear, and now and then a carrot.
rogues.name: Gulp

rogues.bio: Gnaws through cover and anyone behind it.
rogues.name: Chompers

rogues.bio: Builds a dam, holds the dam, defends the dam.
rogues.name: Dam Dan

rogues.bio: Tracks you like a lord on a hunt.
rogues.name: Buck Toothington

rogues.bio: Fells his enemies like trees: loudly.
rogues.name: Timber

rogues.bio: Her lodge is full of other people's carrots.
rogues.name: Lodge Lady

rogues.bio: Hides behind things he has gnawed. They are very thin things.
rogues.name: Gnawman

rogues.bio: Rocket-jumps for science.
rogues.name: Dr. Splash

rogues.bio: Hasn't won a fight yet. Hasn't lost one either: he ran.
rogues.name: Squeaks

rogues.bio: Stuffs his cheeks with ammo and empties them at you.
rogues.name: Cheeks McGee

rogues.bio: Small, quiet, bitey.
rogues.name: Nibbler

rogues.bio: Round, fast and armed with rockets: a bowling ball with opinions.
rogues.name: Pudge

rogues.bio: Bounces round a fight like it's a hamster wheel.
rogues.name: Whisker Biscuit

rogues.bio: Fastest critter in the cage, and he knows it.
rogues.name: Turbo

rogues.bio: Rolls in late, rolls out rich.
rogues.name: Wheelie

templates.d.0: Oi, Director! I see what you're doing!
templates.d.2: The Briar? AGAIN? Who's running this?
templates.d.3: Hey, up there! Pick on someone else!
templates.d.4: I don't play by your rules, Director!
templates.fl.0: A flare! Somebody's getting a present!
templates.gb.1: Sorry, partner. Only one of us wins.
templates.gs.2: Nope. Not dying for this gang.
templates.gspot.2: There! Get over here, all of you!
templates.h.2.lose.0: {w}! You'll pay for every single one!
templates.h.3.lose.0: {w}... {w}... this is fine. THIS IS FINE.
templates.h.3.lose.1: I'll be worse next time, {you}. MUCH worse.
templates.h.3.spot.1: I've been practising, {you}. On trees shaped like you.
templates.h.4.kill.0: You made me what I am, {you}.
templates.h.4.lose.0: I'll be back. I'm always back.
templates.h.4.spot.1: I dream about you, {you}. Not nice dreams.
templates.hunt: Somebody's been sitting still... coming for you, {you}!
templates.o.butterfly_wings.spot.0: Float like a butterfly, {you}... drop like one too!
templates.o.cheese_hat.lose.0: Beaten by a walking cheese board...
templates.o.cheese_hat.spot.0: Is that... CHEESE on your head, {you}?
templates.o.cheese_hat.spot.1: I can smell your hat from here, {you}.
templates.o.dark_wings.spot.1: Ooh, dark wings. I'm SO scared.
templates.o.fedora.lose.0: Tipped my hat to you. Literally.
templates.o.flower_crown.spot.0: Pretty flowers, {you}. Pity about the rest.
templates.o.glasses_3d.lose.0: That one popped off the screen...
templates.o.glasses_3d.spot.0: Ooh, 3D! Watch this carrot come right at you, {you}!
templates.o.golden_acorn.spot.0: Solid gold, {you}? Hold still, I'll melt you down!
templates.o.golden_acorn.spot.1: All that gold won't stop a carrot, {you}.
templates.o.laurel_wreath.spot.1: Nice leaves, champ. Let's see you earn them.
templates.o.mended_mirror.spot.0: Is that a MIRROR, {you}? I'll crack it again!
templates.o.patchwork.spot.0: Nice quilt, {you}. Did your granny make it?
templates.o.patchwork.spot.1: Patches, {you}? I'll give you a few more holes!
templates.o.pixel_shades.spot.0: Deal with it? DEAL WITH THIS, {you}!
templates.o.ring_necklace.spot.1: Is that a ring? Are you proposing, {you}?
templates.o.santa_hat.lose.0: I'm on the naughty list now, aren't I.
templates.o.santa_hat.spot.0: Is it Christmas, {you}? Here's your present!
templates.o.snorkel_mask.spot.0: A snorkel? There's no water here, {you}!
templates.o.star_glasses.spot.1: Star glasses! Who do you think you are?
templates.o.starry_night.spot.1: Look, everyone! A walking night sky!
templates.o.witch_hat.kill.0: No spell for that, was there?
templates.o.wizard_hat.spot.0: A wizard? Pull a carrot out of THAT, {you}!
templates.p.noble.kill.1: Do send my regards to the Burrow, {you}.
templates.p.noble.kill.2: Most unsporting of you to lose.
templates.p.noble.spot.2: I say, {you}, how common of you.
templates.p.scaredy.spot.1: Oh no oh no oh no—
templates.p.showoff.kill.1: Did you get that on camera?
templates.p.sneak.lose.1: You got lucky, {you}. I'll be quieter.
templates.p.sneak.lose.2: Next time you won't see me.
templates.p.zen.kill.0: It was always going to end this way. {k}–{w}.
templates.p.zen.lose.1: Even the river loses to the rock, sometimes.
